scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-01 enhances a wav file with the default backend and writes the output

steps.text: an input wav file exists at <input>
the user runs ims enhance <input> -o <output>
the exit status is 0
an output wav file exists at <output>
the file at <output> is a valid wav
the file at <output> differs from the file at <input>

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-02 enhances a wav file with an explicitly selected backend

steps.text: an input wav file exists at <input>
the user runs ims enhance <input> -o <output> --backend dpdfnet
the exit status is 0
an output wav file exists at <output>

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-03 rejects an unknown backend

steps.text: an input wav file exists at sample.wav
the user runs ims enhance sample.wav -o unused.wav --backend <backend>
the exit status is 2
the error message names the backend <backend>

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-04 fails cleanly when the input path does not exist

steps.text: no file exists at <input>
the user runs ims enhance <input> -o out.wav
the exit status is 1
the error message names the input path <input>

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-05 rejects an unsupported input format

steps.text: an input file exists at <input> in an unsupported format
the user runs ims enhance <input> -o out.wav
the exit status is 1
the error message explains that the input format is unsupported

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-06 rejects an empty audio file

steps.text: an empty wav file exists at empty.wav
the user runs ims enhance empty.wav -o out.wav
the exit status is 1
the error message explains that the input audio is empty

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-07 requires an output path

steps.text: an input wav file exists at sample.wav
the user runs ims enhance sample.wav
the exit status is 2
the error message explains that an output path is required

scenarios.name: Enhance CLI-08 requires an input file

steps.text: the user runs ims enhance -o out.wav
the exit status is 2
the error message explains that an input file is required
